matching_policy.format_adjustment: The pinned directory contains GenBank files only. Exact-stem GenBank candidates are recorded without conversion or payload access; this routine format adjustment does not change the cohort or evaluation rules.

evidence_limits: Declared genome Git blob hashes and sizes are metadata until the corresponding payload bytes are fetched and verified.
Exact filename stems establish a source candidate, not equivalence to an Ando construct, public reference or experimental stock.
No homology-based exclusions, relatedness groups or training/test admissions are established by this audit.
The 53 unused catalog files are not automatically included in the 260-row cohort.
Published testing and mutant roles are retained literally; their future roles require a separately frozen evaluation specification.
No absence of an exact T3 metadata name establishes absence of aliases or homologous sequences.
